recipes.name: Snip + Music
recipes.desc: Short, punchy montage of image snips / short clips with Ken-Burns motion over a music bed. Minimal or no voice. Great for feed/story social ads.
recipes.brief_hint: Build a fast, energetic 12s vertical social ad: a title card, three image beats with Ken-Burns motion, end on a CTA. No voice-over; assume a music bed. Keep copy to short punchy lines.

recipes.name: Full-Motion Tutorial
recipes.desc: Longer narrated spot with a talking avatar/model, real motion clips, captions and a walkthrough feel. Best for explainer / how-it-works ads.
recipes.brief_hint: Build a ~40s vertical explainer ad: open on a title, then alternate real motion clips and a talking spokesperson (model) walking through the product, with captioned steps and a terminal/proof beat, ending on a CTA. Voice-over on; music bed under.
